notes: Added missing API exposure, allowlist configuration, and error handling coverage for tool router enforcement.

stories.title: Tool Allowlist Configuration and Enforcement Layer
stories.description: Implement configurable allowlist definition for permitted tools and enforce strict rejection of any tool not explicitly registered, including structured error responses for disallowed tool access.

stories.title: Tool Router Error Handling and Response Standardization
stories.description: Define and implement standardized error handling for tool routing failures including schema validation errors, missing parameters, and execution exceptions, ensuring consistent responses to the LLM loop.

stories.title: Tool Router Exposure via FastAPI Endpoint
stories.description: Ensure the tool router is properly exposed and invoked through the FastAPI entrypoint, enabling end-to-end tool execution within the conversational loop including request/response wiring.

stories.title: Tool Execution Logging and Audit Trail Integration
stories.description: Integrate tool router execution with debug logging to capture tool selection, input payloads (de-identified where required), validation outcomes, and execution results for audit and debugging.

stories.title: Conversation Context Injection into Tool Calls
stories.description: Ensure chat history and relevant conversation context are correctly injected into tool calls where required, maintaining compatibility with validation schemas and preventing context leakage.
